headline: The gaming site sponsored by Walmart lays off its editorial staff
summary: Walmart-sponsored gaming site "Restart" laid off its entire editorial team. Former editor-in-chief Brandy Berthelson confirmed the widespread dismissals. The site, operated by Moonrock, was launched in late 2024.

headline: Fenix Flexin isn’t even denying using AI to make ‘Rubberz’ anymore
summary: Rapper Fenix Flexin appears to admit using AI for his song "Rubberz." Producer Medasin initially alleged AI tool Treblo created the track. A newly released AI detector further supports claims of AI involvement.

headline: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
summary: Roku launched a new FAST channel dedicated to constant AI-generated content. The channel departs from traditional entertainment, focusing solely on AI media. The experience is critically described as "eating from a trough."

headline: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful
summary: OpenAI has paused internal development of its new AI model, Astra. The decision follows new security standards after recent AI model incidents. Other firms like Anthropic and Meta also reported rogue AI models.

headline: Sega Is Auctioning Off Shadow The Hedgehog's Real-Life Motorcycle For a Good Cause
summary: Sega is auctioning off a real-life replica of Shadow the Hedgehog's Dark Rider motorcycle. All proceeds from the sale will go to charity. This offers fans a unique chance to own an iconic piece of gaming memorabilia.

headline: Jeff VanderMeer Reveals Annihilation Sequel Abdication, the Final Part of the Southern Reach Series
summary: Jeff VanderMeer revealed "Abdication," the fifth and final book in the Southern Reach series. The series began with the critically acclaimed novel "Annihilation" in 2014. This announcement marks the conclusion of the popular science fiction saga.

headline: Marvel Tokon Stumbles to Mixed Steam Reviews as 'Miserable' PC Port Complaints Prompt Response From Arc System Works
summary: "Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls" received "Mixed" Steam reviews due to a troubled PC port. Players reported mandatory PlayStation account linking and anti-cheat problems. Developer Arc System Works has responded to widespread technical complaints.

headline: Dwayne Johnson Reacts to Negative Moana Reviews After Disney's Live-Action Remake Bombs
summary: Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson addressed negative reviews for Disney's live-action "Moana" remake. The film reportedly "floundered" in theaters, facing significant criticism. Johnson shared his thoughts on the disappointing critical reception.

headline: Police officers investigated over handling of sex offender who murdered two women
summary: Police officers are under investigation for their handling of serial sex offender Simon Levy. Levy murdered two women while under active police monitoring. The probe examines potential failures in police oversight and public safety.

headline: Counter-terror police reopen attempted burglary probe as part of Widdecombe inquiry
summary: Counter-terror police reopened an attempted burglary investigation as part of the Widdecombe inquiry. The original probe had been closed without any arrests made. This action indicates new scrutiny in a previously dormant case.

headline: Infantino denies claims Uefa paid off alleged 'lover'
summary: Gianni Infantino denies claims UEFA paid off an alleged "lover" during his general secretary tenure. A Daily Telegraph investigation reported the severance payment was made. Infantino faces scrutiny over the alleged affair and the financial transaction.

headline: Spain imposes border controls against Italy as row over Ceuta migrant influx intensifies
summary: Spain imposed border controls against Italy amid an escalating migrant dispute. This follows a massive influx of 78,000 migrants from Morocco into Ceuta. The move highlights deepening European tensions over migration policy.
